title: A Combine structure is a centred mass with an off-centre skin: plates, layers, leans and turns, and no mirror
rule: Build a Combine wall, gate, tower or hall side in five passes: (1) masses on a 256 bay in 128 courses, which may be centred; (2) plates 2 to 16 thick laid over them; (3) 3 to 6 layers on about a third of the wall; (4) 2 or 3 leans and turns from a short list of simple ratios; (5) the relief of each wall and the two sides of each opening made to differ. It is not random: the rhythm stays on 256, the oddness is in the skin. New Combine pieces only; ask the owner first before changing the checkpoint, depot or armoury, which stand upright and square.
why: d3_citadel_01 to 05, d3_breen_01, ep1_intro, ep1_citadel_00 to 04, styleguide_core (21 November): single detail groups are mirror-true (median 0.91 to 1.0; d3_citadel_03's shaft walls 0.93 to 0.998, d3_breen_01's pillars in mirrored pairs), but 30% of 1082 articulated Combine walls match their mirror below 0.6 (old City 17: 15% of 206), 18.1% of the Combine's visible area is off the axes (old City 17 1.4%), plates are 32 to 74% of its brushes, 3+ layers cover 17 to 67% of its wall area. Notes: _dev/reference/valve_citadel/wip/architecture_notes.md.
how: A map_combine.py generator (proposed): combine_piece(kind, box, seed) lays mass, plate stacks, lean courses and turns by the recipe in the notes and returns convex solids for Vmf.detail_shapes; it throws away a seed whose walls mirror (see valve-combine-no-mirror).
check: proposed: map_combine.py checks its own pieces (mirror match, layer share, off-axis share) before writing

title: The Combine's skin is thin plates, butted, three to six deep on a third of the wall: a big step off the mass, then small reveals
rule: Cover a Combine mass with plates 2, 4, 8 or 16 thick (pick 2 or 3 per piece), 32 to 64 by 64 to 256 (128 the commonest; 1024 for giant ones). Butt them (no gap on 60 to 81% of joins) and give one join in five a reveal of 8, 12, 40 or 48. By wall area: 1 layer on 36 to 61%, 2 on 10 to 29%, 3 to 6 on 17 to 67%. The first layer stands 48, 56 or 64 off the mass, each layer on it 4 or 8 more: steps are big or small, rarely between. New pieces only; ask the owner first before changing a Combine piece already built.
why: Citadel maps (21 November): plates (thinnest side 16 or less, short side 3 times that) 32 to 74% of Combine brushes, median 56%. Thickness tops: 8 (26 to 38% in d3_citadel_02, 05, ep1_citadel_00), 16 (30% d3_citadel_03), 2 (25 to 28% ep1_citadel_01, 03; 39% the Nexus d3_c17_10b). Long side 128 on 22 to 33% in HL2. Same-facing faces within 64 of depth: 3+ layers on 17 to 67% of the area in 14 of 15 maps (the core 3%); steps 64, 48, 56, 4, 8 lead in every map; coplanar joins gap 0 on 60 to 81%, then 8, 12, 40, 48, 64.
how: map_combine.py plate_stack(face, layers): first layer 48 to 64 out, then 4 or 8 per layer, plates from the chosen thicknesses, widths never repeated next to each other, butted with one reveal in five.
check: proposed: map_lint notes a Combine wall of one plate layer longer than 512 (valve-combine-plates)

title: The Combine turns off the grid by simple ratios: 45, 1 in 2, 1 in 4, 22.5; a fifth of its surface is off the axes
rule: Turn Combine faces in plan by 45, 26.6 (1 in 2), 14.0 (1 in 4) or 22.5 (an octagon, its corners on the grid giving 22.2 and 23.5), never a free angle; one piece uses 2 to 4 off-axis directions (a showpiece up to 12). Off-axis area: 4 to 15% for a plain hall, 15 to 35% for a showpiece, 44 to 56% for the core or a wreck; the old city round it stays square (1 to 2%). Make sloped faces from three whole-number points on the 4 to 16 grid, as HL2 did. New pieces only; ask the owner first before turning anything already built.
why: Citadel maps (21 November): 18.1% of 4.6 billion square units of visible Combine area off the axes (3.8% d3_citadel_02, 14 to 15% d3_citadel_03, 05, ep1_citadel_00, 35% ep1_citadel_01, 03, 44% styleguide_core, 56% ep1_intro); intact City 17 (d3_c17_10a, b) 1.4%, ruined (ep1_c17_00, 01) 6.5%. Turned area: 45 is 83% in d3_citadel_02 and 88% in ep1_citadel_01; 1 in 2 24 to 25% in ep1_citadel_00, d3_citadel_05 and 56% in styleguide_destroyed_citadel; 1 in 4 36% in d3_citadel_03; 22.5 (as 22.1 to 22.3 and 23.5) 53% in ep1_citadel_03 and 62% in the core. Detail groups: median 2 to 4 off-axis directions, 90th percentile 4 to 12. HL2's off-axis plane points on a 4, 8 or 16 grid (9% fractional in d3_citadel_02); EP1's mostly fractional (84% in ep1_citadel_03).
how: map_combine.py turn(ratio): rotate a plate stack's plan by one of the four turns, corners snapped to the 4 grid; a piece draws its 2 to 4 turns at the start and keeps to them.
check: proposed: map_combine.py reports each piece's off-axis share and its distinct turn count

title: No Combine wall's relief and no passage's two sides are each other's mirror; the masses under them may be
rule: On a Combine wall with three or more relief levels, make the left and right differ: different layer counts (one side 1 or 2, the other 3 to 5), different step depths, one side leaning and the other plumb, a bay 88 to 408 deep on one side only. The two walls of a passage get different relief. Aim for a third of such walls matching their mirror below 0.6 and passage sides matching below 0.3. Single pillars, a reactor core and a formal office may stay centred. New pieces only; ask the owner first before changing a Combine piece already built.
why: Depth pictures of every wall on an 8 grid, mirrored about the best upright line (21 November): articulated Combine walls 1082, 30% below 0.6 and 43% at 0.9 or more; old City 17 walls 206, 15% and 46%; per-map medians 0.57 (d3_citadel_04) to 1.0 (the core). Passages (walls facing 64 to 640 apart): median match 0.02 (d3_citadel_05), 0.07 (d3_breen_01), 0.04 (styleguide_destroyed_citadel), 0.13 to 0.30 in nine more maps; exceptions d3_citadel_02 0.96, ep1_citadel_04 0.63, the core 1.0; City 17 streets 0.18 to 0.50. Valve's detail groups mirror-true (median 0.91 to 1.0); d3_breen_01's office pillars in mirrored pairs. Nexus picture U27.
how: map_combine.py builds the two sides of an opening from different draws of the plate and layer rules and scores each wall with the depth-picture mirror test (walls.py in the study); a seed scoring 0.9 or more on an articulated wall, or 0.5 or more on a passage, is drawn again.
check: proposed: map_lint kind mirror notes a Combine wall of 3+ relief levels whose relief matches its mirror at 0.9 or more

title: Huge against small: one Combine join in six puts a piece against one 8 times its size, and the texture grows with the piece
rule: Set small Combine parts (plates 2 to 16 thick, 32 to 64 wide) straight against masses 8 to 32 times their size on about one join in six (the old city: one in fifteen). Texture plates near the eye at 0.25 and giant faces at 1 or 2, so the panel pattern grows with the piece. New pieces only; ask the owner first before retexturing anything built.
why: Citadel maps (21 November): touching Combine pairs whose longest sides differ 8 times or more: 15.8% of 148 thousand pairs (16 times: 5.1%); old buildings 6.5% of 24 thousand (1.6%). Combine longest sides median 128 to 512, 90th percentile 512 to 1737. Texture scale on the Combine's area: 0.25 on 39 to 81% in HL2's Citadel, 1.0 on 21 to 55%, 2.0 on 42% in d3_citadel_01 (its giant walls); City 17's old walls 0.25.
how: map_combine.py: each mass gets at least one small plate or fin straight on it; texture scale by the face's longest side (under 512: 0.25; to 1024: 1; over: 2).

title: The Combine keeps a 256 rhythm and breaks it with pairs and odd ones, not with random spacing
rule: Repeat Combine ribs, fins and panels on a 256 pitch (or 128), then break the run: about 2 runs in 5 stay even, 1 in 5 goes in pairs (two pieces 14 to 36 apart, a pair every 143 to 285), the rest take uneven spacings (170, 36, 510). Never scatter at random. New pieces only. Pieces already built keep their look: ask the owner first before changing them.
why: Runs of 3 or more like Combine pieces in a line (21 November): 1345 in the Citadel maps, even 40% (pitch 256 on 416 of them), near even 15%, paired 19%, free 26%; EP1's Citadel freer (51 to 73% uneven) than HL2's (27 to 40%). Old City 17, 162 runs: even 47% (pitch 128), paired 17%, free 22%. Examples: ep1_citadel_03 fins 16 by 32 spaced 32, 160, 32, 160; plates 2 thick 14, 98, 14, 490; d3_citadel_04 slabs 170, 36, 510.
how: map_combine.py rib_run(length, pitch): even, paired or free by the shares above; pairs 14 to 36 apart.

title: Inside an old building the Combine lays plates flush and square; where its own mass arrives it drives in at an angle
rule: Two ways only. Inside an old building, Combine plates lie flush on the old walls, square to them, not cut in (or stand 14 to 16 off). Where a Combine mass meets the old city from outside, it is turned against it by 1 in 2 (27) or 45 and cut 4 to 128 into the old wall or floor. Ask the owner first before changing an old building or Combine piece already built.
why: 21 November. The Nexus (d3_c17_10a, b): 43 to 79% of Combine brushes touch old ones, 2.5 to 6% cut in, 0 to 6% turned, the rest stand 14 to 16 off. ep1_citadel_00 (the Citadel's foot in the old city): 40% of touching Combine brushes cut in (to 64 and 128), 43% turned, 65% of those by 27; ep1_citadel_03 (old concrete under the core) 67% cut in 4 to 13, 29% turned by 45; ep1_c17_00 29% cut in, 29% turned by 13. Nova Prospekt's plates flush on concrete (valve-combine-lean).
how: map_combine.py takes the old wall's plane: inside, plates flush and square; outside, the mass rotated 27 or 45 and sunk 4 to 128 into the old brush (a func_detail, so the old wall keeps sealing).

title: Combine light is set into the plates: flush panels, mostly upright, cold; warm only where it fails
rule: Light a Combine wall with light-panel brushes (lights/white004_nochop or white003_nochop) set flush in the plate layer, 16 to 64 thick, 64 to 192 by 140 to 1150 (small rooms 8 to 16 by 16 to 100 by 48 to 256), upright 3 to 2 over lying, coloured 147 226 240 or 122 173 188; warm 254 95 48 or 249 177 106 only where the place is failing. No flickering (the owner's rule). New pieces only. Pieces already built keep their look: ask the owner first before changing them.
why: Citadel maps (21 November): 11 to 74 light-panel brushes a map; their face flush with the plate beside it on 77 to 100%; d3_citadel_03 to 05 panels 16 to 128 thick, 64 to 457 by 128 to 1280; ep1_citadel_03 2.7 to 23 thick, 15 to 192 by 16 to 392; upright 214 to lying 135. light and light_spot colours: 147 226 240 leads, 122 173 188 in d3_citadel_04, 05; ep1_citadel_01, 02b (the core failing) 254 95 48, 249 177 106, 235 114 33. Glow sprites 1 to 92 a map.
how: map_combine.py swaps one plate of a stack for a light panel of the same size and plane, with a light behind it in the panel's colour.

extra.how: The Citadel (21 November): 128 courses set back 32 or 40 are 72% of leaning Combine area in d3_citadel_02 and 55% in d3_citadel_05, set back 16 (1 in 8) 23% in d3_citadel_03; giant shaft walls 1856 to 2560 high lean 2 to 11 (set back 67 to 346); 43 to 62% of leaning faces look up.

The Citadel's wall props (21 November, 15 maps): 745 Combine pipes, 39% on 15s and 20% on 45s off the walls, 9% rising; 175 combine_light, 10% square; the 39 creeping walls (combineinnerwall*) 74% tilted, mostly rolled near 180 (upside down) and pitched 6 to 54, half at free yaws; combine_intwallunit 86% square, nearest twin 64 to 124 apart.
